inspiration.observed_pattern: The MySQL aggregate reference documents hierarchical GROUP BY ... WITH ROLLUP totals and JSON_OBJECTAGG key/value aggregation as adjacent aggregate capabilities.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a regional revenue manifest. One grouped query emits per-region JSON_OBJECTAGG maps and a final rollup row containing the all-region map and total revenue; unique prefixed keys avoid duplicate-key ambiguity on the super-aggregate row. The source tables, names, values, and documentation examples are not copied.

fixture_notes: Regions north and south contain distinct item codes. Per-region rows map region:item keys to revenue, while the NULL region rollup maps ALL:item keys and totals every row. The explicit key prefix prevents duplicate JSON object keys across rollup levels.
determinism_notes: Sale IDs, regions, item codes, revenue values, JSON keys, grouping, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE regional_revenue (sale_id INT PRIMARY KEY, region_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, item_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, revenue INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT region_code, JSON_OBJECTAGG(CONCAT(COALESCE(region_code, 'ALL'), ':', item_code), revenue) AS revenue_map, SUM(revenue) AS region_total FROM regional_revenue GROUP BY region_code WITH ROLLUP
